# Southron Firm, P.A.

> > Tampa-based business and construction law firm serving Florida clients with transactional legal services, real estate matters, and construction lien enforcement.

Southron Firm, P.A. provides comprehensive legal guidance for Florida businesses, contractors, and property owners. The firm specializes in business formation, construction law under Chapter 713, contract drafting and disputes, real estate transactions, and estate planning throughout the Tampa Bay area and across Florida.

## Key Topics

- Florida construction liens (Chapter 713)
- Business formation and registration
- Contract law and disputes
- Notice to Owner requirements
- Notice of Intent to Lien
- Florida real estate transactions
- Buy-sell agreements
- Construction contracts
- Estate tax planning
- Partnership dissolution
- Promissory notes
- Florida Sunbiz annual reports
- EIN requirements
- Short sale proceedings
- Tampa business law

## Construction Law & Liens

- [How to File a Construction Lien in Florida](https://www.southronfirm.com/blog/2025/florida-construction-lien-process): Step-by-step guide to filing construction liens under Chapter 713
- [Sending a Notice to Owner in Florida: Protect You Rights](https://www.southronfirm.com/blog/2025/sending-a-notice-to-owner-florida): How to send Notice to Owner per Florida Statute §713.06 for lien rights
- [How to Draft and Send a Notice of Intent to Lien](https://www.southronfirm.com/blog/2025/notice-of-intent-to-lien-send): Guide to drafting Notice of Intent to Lien under Florida Chapter 713
- [Construction Contracts: Drafting, Negotiation, and Review](https://www.southronfirm.com/blog/2025/construction-contracts-guide-to-success): Tampa attorneys guide to construction contract types and negotiation

## Business Formation & Compliance

- [9 Easy Steps to Create a New Business](https://www.southronfirm.com/blog/2020/9-easy-steps-to-create-a-new-business): Complete startup guide for Florida business formation and registration
- [Why Filing Your Sunbiz Business Annual Report is Crucial](https://www.southronfirm.com/blog/2025/filing-your-annual-report-for-business-compliance): Florida Sunbiz annual report filing requirements and deadlines
- [Do I Need an EIN Number for My Florida Business?](https://www.southronfirm.com/blog/2025/ein-number-florida): IRS EIN requirements for Florida businesses and tax compliance
- [5 Key Reasons Your Business Needs a Buy Sell Agreement](https://www.southronfirm.com/blog/2025/reasons-your-business-needs-a-buy-sell-agreement): Why Florida businesses need buy-sell agreements for succession planning
- [How to Dissolve a Partnership in Florida](https://www.southronfirm.com/blog/2024/how-to-dissolve-a-partnership): Partnership dissolution steps under Florida's Revised Uniform Act

## Real Estate & Property Law

- [Florida Real Estate Transactions: Protect Your Investment](https://www.southronfirm.com/blog/2025/florida-real-estate-transactions): Legal guidance for Florida real estate transactions and closings
- [Florida Short Sale Attorney to Avoid Foreclosure](https://www.southronfirm.com/blog/2025/short-sale-florida): Short sale legal services to avoid foreclosure in Florida

## Contract Law

- [Promissory Note: Expert Drafting and Enforcement](https://www.southronfirm.com/blog/2025/promissory-note-elements-and-guide): Tampa attorneys draft and enforce legally sound promissory notes
- [What is the Doctrine of Substantial Performance in Contract Law?](https://www.southronfirm.com/blog/2024/substantial-performance-contract-law): Doctrine allowing contract fulfillment despite minor incomplete terms
- [What Does the Application of Contract of Adhesion Mean?](https://www.southronfirm.com/blog/2024/what-does-the-application-of-contract-of-adhesion-mean): Explaining contracts of adhesion and non-negotiable standard agreements
